facts.title: Blue Cheese Dressing
ingredients: ¾ cup (3 ounces) crumbled blue cheese, such as Gorgonzola dolce
2 tablespoons thinly sliced chives or green onion (mostly green parts)
1 small clove garlic, pressed or minced
¼ teaspoon fine salt, to taste
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: In a small bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Taste, and add another pinch of salt and/or several more twists of black pepper until it’s just right. For the best flavor, let the mixture chill for 30 minutes before serving.
Drizzle over your salad or cover and refrigerate for later. Leftovers will keep well in the refrigerator in an air-tight container for up to 1 week.

facts.summary: Blue cheese dressing is a classic for good reason! Blue cheese adds some funk to this irresistibly creamy, tangy dressing, while chives keep it fresh. Recipe yields 1 ½ cups.
